transparency.saturated_color_test: R > 220 and B < 40 and (G < 40 or G > 220); diagnostic only, may include intended palette pixels

observations: One bald brown-skinned angel identity with white/silver-and-gold armor and white feathered wings throughout; runtime gender presentation retained without sexualization.
All 32 sprites are complete at source review; no wing, hand or boot intersects an outer image edge, and neighboring figures remain separated.
Genuine rear-quarter shoulder, torso, rear skirt-panel and wing overlaps are visible in NE/NW; these are not front torsos with hidden eyes.
Rising row uses lifted/open wings, raised arms and flexed knees; descending row lowers wings, brings hands forward and extends boots downward.
Landing uses deeper profile knee bending and lower pelvis than anticipation; anatomical head size appears broadly consistent across rows.
Hands are empty, with no wand, weapon, shield, baked magic, labels, floor or cast shadow.
limitations: Colored red/yellow edge speckles are visible in the original viewer. Most saturated red/yellow diagnostic pixels have alpha below 128, but 111 pass alpha >= 128; some may be intended gold. Lead must review cleanup results.
Partial alpha is substantial and zero-alpha pixels retain some RGB. No alpha thresholding, hidden-RGB removal, registration, cropping, downsampling or other pixel editing was performed.
Front/back landing compression is subtler than profile landing compression and should be checked at common native scale.
Some descending oblique/profile poses keep a trailing knee flexed; their forward/downward ready boot still differentiates them from the rise. Transition readability requires native-scale review.
Raised wings increase row-two overall envelope; do not fit each sprite to its own box or derive body scale from wing envelope.
Exact anatomical pixel lengths and native-scale skull continuity are unverified; source-size visual review is not runtime acceptance.
These are four authored keys, not full animation cycles or cast animation.
